text:
tess: Support -> CS escalation: LumosCare onboarding seed failing intermittently with 502s during large embed upload. AE flagged renewal as at-risk — they have a customer demo in 16 hours. Need quick triage + short customer note.

omar: Can we get the last proxy lines? Need to confirm if it's rate limit vs runner timeout. :mag:

liam: paste: `2024-06-18T11:02:05Z WARN rate_limiter tenant=lumoscare qps=780 limit=600` then `2024-06-18T11:02:22Z ERROR proxy upstream read timeout model-runner-21`. No auth issues. Looks like a burst over tenant qps followed by runner tail latency.

liam: Ops mitigation suggestions: (1) short tenant QPS bump for tonight's seed, (2) route ingest traffic to a less-loaded model-runner pool (same model), (3) ask LumosCare to reduce concurrent workers and batch_size. Command to bump QPS: `infra tenant update-qps lumoscare --qps 1400 --note "onboard seed bump"`

omar: Prefer avoid model changes to keep embeddings stable. Plan: apply temporary QPS bump + ask customer to throttle to 4 workers and batch_size=12. Tess, can you draft the CS note?

tess: Drafting now: "Hi LumosCare team  we're seeing intermittent throttling on large imports. For tonight's seed could you reduce concurrent workers to 4 and set batch_size to 12? We're enabling a brief capacity bump on our side and will update within 20 minutes. Apologies for the disruption  we'll follow up with a post-demo recap." Send in 5?

omar: Add ETA: confirm in 20m and target full resolution in 3 hours. Also log renewal-risk in CRM and attach incident.

ops-bot: Incident INC-20240618-77 opened by liam  priority=P1  lumoscare ingest throttling. PagerDuty notified. https://redwood.incidents/INC-20240618-77

liam: QPS bump applied at 2999999985. Monitoring started. Autoscale provisional rule set for model-runner-21 (cpu>70% window=90s).

tess: Sent customer note at 2999999990. Customer ACKed and will throttle workers. They asked: "Will this change embeddings if you bump capacity?"

omar: Reply to customer: the bump does NOT change model weights; embeddings unchanged unless we switch models. Sending now.

liam: 10m check @2999999995: error rate down ~90%, occasional 429s <1/min, CPU on model-runner-21 peaked then stabilized. Keeping monitors for 3 hours.

tess: AE notified and renewal-risk flagged. Action owners: ops (liam) monitor & remove bump after stability, CS (tess) prepare customer-facing recap after demo, AE (omar) coordinate renewal playbook.

omar: Please include in postmortem: timeline, customer impact, mitigation, and long-term fixes (ingest pre-warm, qps smoothing, SDK guidance for chunking). Reopen if errors recur. :white_check_mark:
